name: Living History Youth Summer Institute, Museum of the American Revolution
what_you_do: Spend six weeks learning to act as a person from history, in costume. You focus on the lives of people of African descent in the time of the Revolution. You go on field trips and do museum career workshops. It ends with a public Interpretation Day.
who_can_apply: High school and college students. You must be able to go on weekdays for the whole program. You must live close enough to the museum to travel there each day.
pay_detail: The page says it is a paid six-week program. The pay amount is not stated. Public transportation help is offered.
duration: 6 weeks, weekdays (the 2023 session ran July 5 to August 11)
deadline_text: The page names a 2026 session but gives no application dates. The 2026 program is finished and no 2027 dates are posted.
how_to_apply: The program page does not explain how to apply. Contact the museum education team through the museum website.
notes: This is a small program. The 2023 press release said eight took part. It is part of the museum's African American Interpretive Program. Check the museum site for the next call for applications.
